title: Backbone Integration, Portability and Gated-Work Readiness Handoff
objective: Integrate the entire MIB program and leave unavailable future work cheaper, safer and more mechanical without performing gated deployment, distribution, provider activation or blocked reconstruction.

scope.purpose: Integrate the entire MIB program and leave unavailable future work cheaper, safer and more mechanical.
deliverables: cross-MIB integration fixture and validation profile
portable test/evidence package for future Mac/Apple and hosted-provider environments
distribution/tester-environment readiness checklist without performing distribution
T04/WP-011/DS-008 boundary map showing what MIB can pre-satisfy and what still requires the missing condition
future implementation handoff map identifying remaining true external blockers versus ordinary implementation work
scope.completion_gate: The backbone passes exact-head repository health, self-hosted Windows/Linux and deterministic comparison where applicable; blocked/gated work has explicit portable inputs and no MIB tranche leaves an undocumented shared primitive or one-off duplicate foundation.

selection_boundaries: MIB-18 application proof is merged and exact-head validated on Linux, Windows and deterministic cross-platform comparison.
ARI is included in the compatibility/integration matrix and portability/readiness handoff while its interfaces remain available to later SAA work.
CCTI-12-T04, WP-011, DS-008 blocked reconstruction, tester distribution/public deployment and paid/live-provider activation remain gated by their own missing conditions.
MIB-18 introduced no competing registry/index/runtime/adapter/component foundation and no schema migration.
MIB implementation authority is retired after this completed_verified family-terminal checkpoint.
SMB-01 is selected_not_started only; no SMB implementation branch or authority exists.
next_action: MIB is closed. SMB-01 is the strict selected_not_started successor. On the next owner Continue, governed-start SMB-01 under OPS3 without reopening MIB.

execution_conformance.execution_quality_note: MIB-18 governed-started, established a clean RED, repaired one type-only assertion defect, passed the full exact-head cross-platform profile, merged byte-identical validated content, closed MIB and selected SMB-01 within one owner Continue tranche.
